students.title: Students
students.description: The school's student register: records, enrollment, guardians and accounts.
students.newDescription: Create a student record. An account can be linked later with an invitation code.
students.importDescription: Add many student records at once from a CSV file.
students.loadError: Some results could not be loaded.
students.created: The student record has been created.
students.changeStatusHint: Leaving statuses end the active enrollment on the effective date.
students.reasonHint: Required for every status except active. Recorded in the history.
students.addGuardianHint: Choose an existing guardian or enter a new one.
students.guardianAlreadyLinked: This guardian is already linked to the student.
students.unlinkDescription: {name} will no longer see this student's records.
students.accountNoneHint: The student has no account. Give them a personal invitation code to register.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Teachers and school employees, their assignments and accounts.
staff.newDescription: Create a staff record. Class assignments are made in Classes.
staff.importDescription: Add many staff records at once from a CSV file.
staff.search: Search by name, number or position
staff.accountNoneHint: This person has no account. Give them a personal invitation code to register.
staff.created: The staff record has been created.
staff.noAssignments: No class subjects assigned this year.

guardians.title: Parents and guardians
guardians.description: Guardian records linked to students. Linking is done from the student record.
guardians.newHint: Create a guardian record, then link it from the student record.
guardians.search: Search by name, phone or email
guardians.archiveDescription: The record is kept for history but hidden from lists.

users.title: User accounts
users.description: Accounts that can sign in, their roles and status.
users.search: Search by name, email or account ID
users.loadError: The accounts could not be loaded.
users.blockDescription: The person will be signed out and unable to sign in until unblocked.
users.pendingHint: This account is waiting for registration approval.
users.rolesHint: You can assign only roles whose permissions you hold yourself.
users.ownRolesHint: You cannot change your own roles.

approvals.title: Registration approvals
approvals.description: People who registered and are waiting for access. Check their identity before approving.
approvals.emptyReviewed: No requests have been reviewed yet.
approvals.rejectDescription: {name} will be told that the request was rejected.
approvals.approved: The request has been approved and the account activated.

invitations.title: Invitation codes
invitations.description: Codes let people register directly with a role. Personal codes link the account to an existing record.
invitations.newHint: A shared code for a group, for example a class or the teaching staff.
invitations.classHint: For student codes: enroll into this class on approval.
invitations.created: The invitation code has been created.

import.instructions: Prepare a CSV file (UTF-8, comma or semicolon separated) with a header row using the column names below. Dates use the format YYYY-MM-DD.

hints.students: gender: male or female. class_name must match a class of the current academic year.
hints.staff: staff_type: teacher, director, vice_principal, librarian, administrator, support or other.
hints.classes: grade_level: 1–11. shift: 1–3. homeroom_employee_number must match an existing staff record.

import.fileRules: Choose a .csv file up to 2 MB.
import.tooManyRows: The file has more than {max} rows. Split it into smaller files.
import.invalid: {rows} of {total} rows have problems. Nothing has been imported. Fix the file and upload it again.
import.done: {created} records have been created. The import is recorded in the audit log.

years.title: Academic years and terms
years.description: The school calendar: the current academic year and its grading terms.
years.makeCurrentHint: Classes, enrollment and dashboards use the current year.
years.makeCurrentDescription: {name} becomes the current academic year for the whole school.
years.closeDescription: A closed year stays available for history and reports.
years.emptyHint: Create the first academic year to start.
years.addTermHint: Quarters, semesters, exam periods or holidays.
years.lockDescription: Teachers will no longer be able to add or change grades for this term.
years.unlockDescription: Teachers will be able to change grades for this term again.
years.deleteTermDescription: Terms with recorded grades cannot be deleted.
years.created: The academic year has been created.
years.termInUse: The term has grades and cannot be deleted.
years.termLocked: Grading for the term is locked.
years.termUnlocked: Grading for the term is open.

classes.newHint: The class is created in the {year} academic year.

classes.noYear: There is no academic year yet.

classes.promoteHint: Move students into a class of another academic year. Their current enrollment is completed.

subjects.archiveDescription: It will no longer be offered for new class assignments.

timetable.sunday: There are no lessons on Sunday.
timetable.noLessonsOnDay: No lessons are scheduled for this day.
timetable.newSubstitutionHint: Leave the substitute empty to record the lesson as cancelled.
timetable.substituteHint: Teachers busy in that period are rejected.
